review_notes: I read the whole target file. I also read the definitions of expandingReactionHistory and expandingProfileReaction, and the sibling files ExpandingProfileEquation.lean and ExpandingProfileEnergyDerivative.lean. A grep found the same `add_zero _` unfolding proof in five files. I did not find any existing `_apply` or `_zero_apply` simp lemma for either definition. I could not run Lean, so I have not checked that the proposed lemmas compile or that they fire in these call sites. I also did not examine the effect of the `local irreducible` attribute on the proofs beyond noting it. Beyond this one pattern I found nothing else about the simp interface in the file.

findings.problem: The reaction history `r τ` is `expandingReactionHistory T hT F S τ`, which unfolds to `F (projIcc .., S (projIcc ..))`. With `F := expandingProfileReaction .. q 0`, this unfolds to `-I • fderiv .. + (0 : C(..)) (projIcc ..)`. The simplifier cannot reduce this to the forcing term, because neither definition has an `_apply` lemma. The proof therefore needs a hand-written `hforce`, a `change` that exposes the `+ 0` by defeq, and `exact add_zero _`. The same unfolding is repeated in four sibling files: ExpandingProfileEquation (`change -Complex.I • (_ : FourierL2) + (0 : FourierL2) = _`), ExpandingProfileEnergyDerivative, ExpandingProfileObservation, ExpandingProfileLimitEquation and ExpandingProfileTimeEquicontinuity. Each copy depends on the exact elaborated shape of the definitions. The `attribute [local irreducible]` on line 16 is a further sign that normal-form lemmas are missing, since these definitions are being hidden from defeq checking by hand.
findings.proposed_change: Add `@[simp]` unfolding lemmas next to the definitions. First: `theorem expandingReactionHistory_apply : expandingReactionHistory T hT F u t = F (projIcc 0 T hT t, u (projIcc 0 T hT t)) := rfl`. Second: `theorem expandingProfileReaction_apply : expandingProfileReaction a k T ha ha1 hk m l q g (t, v) = -Complex.I • fderiv ℝ (expandingOddPower a k (l t).1 ha ha1 hk (l t).2 m) (q t) v + g t := rfl`. Then add a derived `expandingProfileReaction_zero_apply` that simplifies the `0` forcing term via `ContinuousMap.zero_apply` and `add_zero`. With these, `hforce` becomes a plain `simp [r, F, expandingReactionHistory_apply, expandingProfileReaction_zero_apply]`. The shared `change`/`add_zero` boilerplate can then be dropped in all five files, and `simp_rw [hforce] at he` could be replaced by simp using the same lemmas.
findings.benefit: Every use of the reaction history for the unforced profile equation reduces to the same normal form, `-I • fderiv ..`, without hand-written `change` proofs that depend on the definitions' internal shape. This removes duplicated proof fragments in five files. It also makes the proofs more robust to later changes in the definitions, and it may remove the need for the `local irreducible` workaround.
